description: Requires sign-in and the routes:write permission. Save a GPX file to the traveller's ride routes. Pass the file contents as text in gpx (up to 64 KB) and an optional name. Returns the saved route, or duplicate=true if the same file is already saved.

gpx.description: The full GPX file contents as text (up to 64 KB).

name: import_ride_route
title: Save a GPX ride route
